scenes.title:
Fall leaves leave
a green film
scenes.sub:
Las hojas de otoño dejan
una capa verde
scenes.say: Those fall leaves leave a slippery green film on your driveway.

scenes.title:
It gets slippery
and stains
scenes.say: It gets slippery when it rains, and it stains the concrete.

scenes.title: 2-car driveway
scenes.say: We wash a two car driveway from one hundred dollars. Send us a photo for your price.
